items.title: Lambda timeout triage
items.content:
# Lambda timeout triage

1. Identify impacted function names and versions.
2. Inspect CloudWatch logs and metric anomalies.
3. Validate timeout and memory settings against payload profiles.
4. Check downstream dependencies for latency regressions.
5. Roll out mitigations and confirm error-rate recovery.

items.title: Multi-region availability review
items.content:
# Multi-region availability review

1. Confirm target regions and launch objectives.
2. Run aws___get_regional_availability with explicit filters.
3. Record status deltas across isAvailableIn, isBeingPlannedIn, and isNotExpandingIn.
4. Flag region-specific blockers for release readiness.
